WQ Files is a file browser, app data manager and cache cleaner for iOS 27. "WQ" stands for worse_query, the sandbox technique it is built on. It reaches other apps' and system containers with no jailbreak and no kernel exploit. 

Requires: iOS 27, or iOS 26.0 – 26.7.2 (preliminary support). Tested on iOS 27.0.1, 27.2.1 and 26.7.1.
Tools:

Apps: every app with its data size. Back up an app's data, restore the latest backup, clear its data (Documents, Library, tmp), open its folder, or share a backup as a ZIP over AirDrop, Files, Mail and so on.
Cache Cleaner: cache and temp size per app, with search, Select All / None / Large Caches (50 MB+) and crash logs. Long-press an app to jump to its Caches, tmp or data folder.
Files: browse, read and share files; each opens in the fitting tool, and Open As switches between them. Saving writes back in place (same inode, owner and attributes). Create folders, import files, rename and delete. Long-press a folder to share it as a ZIP.
Plist editor: browse dictionaries and arrays, edit values by type (switches for booleans, numbers, text, dates, data as hex), add, delete, rename and reorder. Saves in the file's own format (binary or XML).
Hex viewer and editor: any file size (read in pages), go to offset, find hex bytes or text, overwrite bytes in place. Changed bytes are highlighted until saved; the file size never changes.
Text and images: text is editable, images render, plists can also be edited as XML text.
Log: everything the app changed, plus the App Group it received.
⚠️ App Groups entitlement required
